primary_contrast.estimand: per-base-seed difference of separately selected served official VALID Hits@50
primary_contrast.endpoint_status: development pilot after validation selection; optimistic, not confirmatory TEST evidence

native_recipe_adaptations.rng: seed Python in addition to native Torch/NumPy for current PyG sampler
native_recipe_adaptations.checkpoint: strict served Hits50 selector, first candidate always persisted; no multi-metric overwrite
native_recipe_adaptations.runtime: qualified contemporary Torch/CUDA/PyG, not old author environment

single_donor_reuse.donor: native I4 member0 in same block
single_donor_reuse.other_native_members: independent full learned encoders/decoders/RNG/optimizers; no shared trainable parameters

factor_initialization.kind: Rademacher ±1 for all r/s parameters, fixed before outcomes
factor_initialization.constructor_seed: base seed s, Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/selected CUDA
factor_initialization.order: lexicographically sorted full named parameter paths ending .r or .s, including unused ptlin

twin_pairing.sampler_permutation_dropout_call_schedul: native epoch ordering, same per-epoch negative/permutation hashes and RNG-consumption identities for both twins
twin_pairing.route_switch: own clamped completion weights versus member mean after clamp; receiving member features/context/decoder unchanged
twin_pairing.native_independent_fit_streams: isolated persisted model-specific RNG; scheduling cannot change them

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.native_independent_loss: one native positive mean plus one native negative mean per independently updated model; no 1/4 scaling
optimizer.factorized_loss: positive mean over query/member entries plus negative mean over query/member entries

data_graph.split: official OGB time split; no reconstructed year filter
data_graph.train_graph: all official TRAIN records; unweighted symmetric, all nodes; no year/LCC reduction
data_graph.training_target_removal: whole positive record minibatch before symmetric reconstruction, surviving duplicates retained
data_graph.decoder_graph: original masked graph before encoder directed edge dropout
data_graph.validation_graph: complete TRAIN for encoder and all completion/query structure
data_graph.validation_queries: all official VALID positives and shared official negatives, original order
data_graph.eventual_test_graph_policy: native-collab-VAL-at-TEST; complete TRAIN+VALID positives for encoder and all query structure

negative_and_order.refresh: once per native epoch before PermIterator
negative_and_order.sampler_shortage: fail if sampled rows cannot index all TRAIN record ids; retain failure, no replacement draw
negative_and_order.order: native PermIterator random permutation, full batches only; drop shuffled tail
negative_and_order.eval_order: native nontraining PermIterator arange including tail

serving_metric.negative_pool: entire official shared split negative pool
serving_metric.hit_rule: positive raw served score strictly greater than 50th largest negative raw served score; ties fail

selection.replace: strict served VALID Hits50 improvement only

independent_ensemble_candidates.additional_candidate_order101: bank of each native member individually selected by own strict VALID Hits50 criterion
independent_ensemble_candidates.rule: strict served ensemble Hits50 improvement over ordered union; first ties retained

selection.prediction_visibility: internal selection only until complete core-plus-N70 family closure; no live comparisons or curves to agent

auxiliary_native_single.essential_before_claim: candidate advantage beyond ordinary same-parameter single capacity

analysis.paired_seeds_meaning: optimizer/training randomness conditional on one graph/time split, not independent graph samples

lock: all admitted core and required N70 arm/seed cells
heldout_barrier.final_test_if_released: same frozen selected models and contrast once; no VALID refit/calibration/tuning
